tested_invariants: External mutable inputs and returned document/provenance copies cannot mutate EffectiveConfig or its digest.

Already typed query/output leaves pass through by identity; events queries enable required observation with provenance.
File discovery searches ancestors; project discovery stops at its root; competing default files reject.
Config-file paths resolve relative to its directory; higher resource overrides retain override provenance.
Precise native preset and mode/ai aliases preserve choices; inactive controls and conflicting relations reject.
Duplicate JSON/YAML keys and unsafe YAML object tags yield ConfigurationError.
Cyclic mapping now yields ConfigurationError without recursion escape.
Output Mapping and equivalent OutputSpec yield identical effective documents and digest; unknown output fields raise ConfigurationError in both config and output argument tiers (MAINT/API).
